text: The most general rule that I can give you for the world, and which your experience will convince you of the truth of, is, Never to give the tone to the company, but to take it from them; and to labor more to put them in conceit with themselves, than to make them admire you.
author: Philip Stanhope, 4th Earl of Chesterfield
locator: Letter CXVII, to his son, London, July 9, Old Style 1750
